why: the named falsifier: a manifest that fits the budget only because two of the three pipelines are missing from it — review R14's finding, which is that the inherited cost model counted lessons only while Stories and Radio ride the same cast and the same budget

lessonsOnly.note: 50 MB against a 120 MB budget looks comfortable, and is the exact shape of the estimate R14 refuted: two of the three denominators are absent

overBudget.note: a lesson bank that outgrew its reservation is charged what it costs, not what it was promised

noCodecRow.note: R13: 8,000 utterances inside 35-40 MB is 4.4 KB each; a budget with no codec and no bitrate beside it cannot be argued with, which is how the impossible figure survived

mustNotBe: a manifest passing the budget gate while the story or radio pipeline is absent (an implicit zero the lesson bank then grows into); a declared_bytes that is not the sum of max(baked, reserved) over all three pipelines; a manifest with no codec or no bitrate; or a total over the declared budget reported as green
